title.narrative: Promotion of sustainable energy practices in the garment sector in Cambodia

description.narrative: This Action is funded by SWITCH ASIA funds, and implemented by GGGI (lead applicant), GERES (NGO, co-applicant), and GMAC (Garment Manufacturers Association of Cambodia co-applicant). It specific objective is increased investment in sustainable energy practices (such as efficient technologies, switch to renewable energy and good operations management) by garment factories in Cambodia. It aims at the 4 following outputs: 1. Relevant government institutions initiate a series of regulatory measures to incentivize private investment in sustainable energy practices. 2. Institutional arrangements and capacities are developed for adoption of enforcement measures and to improve data availability supporting the sectors switch to sustainable energy practices. 3. Awareness is raised and demand for appropriate technologies and advisory services for sustainable energy practices increased among value-chain stakeholders. 4. Garment factories have access to a range of technical and financial services including a guarantee fund to support their switch towards sustainable energy practices.
